data.source_role: public NIH proxy partition treated as restricted for lifecycle testing
data.image_cache: ephemeral CPU latents for selected dry-run records only; no disk cache
data.private_identifiers: permitted only in a LOCAL_RESTRICTED diagnostic excluded from any release package

runtime.m1_control: M1-I8 and M1-G8 share the same Poisson image schedule and diffusion timestep/noise draws but use independent DP Gaussian streams
runtime.m2_within_patient: uniform without replacement up to four K5 records; use all records when fewer than four
runtime.empty_poisson_sample: execute Gaussian-noise-only optimizer update; never condition or resample
runtime.checkpoint: none; every dry-run model is destroyed after the fourth step

randomness.master_entropy: 256 bits from the operating-system entropy pool, process-memory only
randomness.torch_streams: domain-separated 63-bit seeds derived in process; default CPU/CUDA PyTorch generators
randomness.public_trace: one completed schedule-only event per optimizer step; no selected IDs, realized counts, or seeds

resource_fail_closed.action: abort the complete dry-run without resampling and retain failure diagnostics

pass_criteria: all three arms complete exactly four optimizer steps
M1 arms use identical selected image units and identical diffusion draws at each matched step
every nonempty sampled unit yields one finite fp32 full LoRA gradient and M2 averages within patient before clipping
empty samples, if realized, still yield a finite Gaussian-noise-only optimizer step
every update uses the frozen C, sigma, q, adjacency, and fixed public denominator
all adapter parameters and optimizer states remain finite and each arm changes from its common initial digest
each public runtime trace has four valid chained schedule-only events and both accountants replay exactly at four events
no model, adapter, latent, gradient bank, DP seed, or generated image is persisted
independent verification passes without importing the runner or mechanism
prohibited_interpretations: four steps do not establish training convergence, utility, privacy attack resistance, or a DP release
realized clipping or losses cannot change the frozen K5/K10 arm matrix, C, sigma, step count, or dataset
the public NIH proxy does not become confidential merely because its private_train role is exercised
these three benchmark models are not jointly authorized for release
next_if_pass: report first; then decide whether to implement the separately frozen 4000-step K5 one-seed feasibility matrix including M0
next_if_fail: retain the failed dry-run and diagnose implementation or resource incompatibility without changing privacy parameters from observed outcomes
